title: Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) Acquires Music Analytics Start-Up “Asaii” to compete with Spotify
text:
October 15, 2018 Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) Acquires Music Analytics Start-Up “Asaii” to compete with Spotify
Axios reported on Sunday, that Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has acquired music analytics start-up Asaii, in a bid to strengthen content recommendations to its music users.
The deal by Apple to buy Asaii was worth less than $100 million, as reported by Axios, citing a source.
The music analytics start-up, Asaii can help Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) to compete with Spotify Technology’s efforts to work directly with smaller artists, like a music label, the report by Axios added.
Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) had completed the acquisition of music discovery app Shazam, in last month, a move by the tech company, to help it compete with Spotify with better equipped, because Spotify is a tough rival as it’s a industry leader in music streaming services.
When reached out to Apple and Asaii, both were not immediately available, for giving any comment on this deal outside the regular business hours.
